prompt:
Use case: style-transfer. Redraw Image 1 completely in the clean flat-color fantasy comic style of Image 2. Image 1 = event content and composition target. Image 2 = ONLY the approved style reference, not its character identity, clothes or tavern.
Preserve the original landscape 3:2 composition and output at 1536 x 1024. Keep the event's important characters, relationships, props and place, with the narrative moment described below. Remove the original painterly rendering, do not merely apply a filter.
STYLE: fine dark organic hand-inked contours, sparse purposeful interior strokes, expressive simplified faces, believable stylized anatomy. Large clean uninterrupted opaque flat colors. One base color and one or two crisp cel-shadow shapes per material. Match the approved reference's smooth skin, cloth and leather. Depict age and wear with only a few contour nicks and structure lines, not speckling. Simplify foliage, stone and wood into large shapes rather than hundreds of marks. Maintain a strong, immediately readable storytelling silhouette.
COLOR: adapt distinct clear cool/warm colors to the scene; cool teal/blue/green opposed to warm brick-red/ochre, selective gold and ivory highlights, blue or muted purple shadows. Do not give every character the reference costume or put castles into scenes that do not require them. Faces and key props stay legible, including night and fog scenes. Light sources and magic are simple colored shapes, no bloom or volumetric glow.
NO pervasive distressed texture, grunge, paper/parchment grain, dirty wash, dense crosshatching, muddy brown filter, photo materials, realistic painterly blending, glossy 3D, thick heavy outlines, UI, captions, text, borders, logos or watermark. One full-bleed illustration.
EVENT: A grizzled veteran with a wooden training staff teaching travelers how to fall safely onto thick straw mats beside a country road, one armored apprentice landing awkwardly while others laugh kindly. Lively physical training composition, weathered armor, hay gold and dusty blue, friendly instructor, no injury or text.
CONTENT CONSTRAINTS: Preserve friendly elderly veteran with wooden practice staff, thick straw mats, awkward falling adult apprentice and amused onlookers. Clear body anatomy, no injuries. Clean straw-gold and cool-blue color areas.
